title: International Coast Guard Fleet Review 2027
subtitle: ICGFR 2027
reviewing_authority: President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu
about: The International Coast Guard Fleet Review (ICGFR 2027) is the centrepiece event of the 5th Coast Guard Global Summit. For the first time in South Asia, coast guard and maritime law enforcement vessels from across the globe will assemble in the waters of the Bay of Bengal off Chennai, demonstrating the unity, strength, and collaborative spirit of the world's maritime community. The Fleet Review is a proud tradition that symbolises international solidarity on the high seas.
significance: The 2027 review carries special significance as it coincides with the Golden Jubilee — 50 years of the Indian Coast Guard (est. 1 February 1977). It marks India's assumption of the CGGS Presidency and showcases the nation's growing maritime power and its commitment to regional peace and security under the SAGAR initiative.

history.notes: First-ever International Coast Guard Fleet Review, conducted alongside the inaugural CGGS in Tokyo Bay.
Expanded participation from Southeast Asia and the Pacific. Historic joint search-and-rescue demonstration exercise.
First fleet review in ASEAN waters. Introduced environmental protection demonstration drill.
First fleet review in European waters; integrated Mediterranean theatre ships and EU border patrol vessels.
Largest ICGFR ever conducted. First in the Indian Ocean Region. Golden Jubilee of the Indian Coast Guard.

objectives.title: Demonstrate Maritime Unity
objectives.description: Showcase the collective strength and cooperative spirit of coast guard agencies from across the globe.

objectives.title: Promote Interoperability
objectives.description: Conduct joint tactical manoeuvres and SAR demonstrations to test and strengthen combined maritime capabilities.

objectives.title: Honour India's Maritime Heritage
objectives.description: Celebrate 50 years of the Indian Coast Guard and India's strategic position in the Indian Ocean Region.

objectives.title: Signal Regional Stability
objectives.description: Affirm India's SAGAR vision — Security and Growth for All in the Region — through visible maritime diplomacy.

objectives.title: Inspire Public Engagement
objectives.description: Open select elements to the public and media to foster broader appreciation for maritime security.

programme.activity: Delegates and dignitaries board Reviewing Vessel at Chennai Port Trust Wharf
President of India arrives — Guard of Honour and National Salute
Reviewing Vessel (ICGS Samudra Paheredar) departs wharf
Fleet Review commences — vessels arranged in three columns off the Chennai coast
Presidential Review of Fleet — steaming past all 48 vessels with gun salutes and coloured bunting
Joint Maritime SAR Demonstration — multi-nation rescue exercise with helicopters and fast-attack craft
Environmental Protection Drill — oil spill containment demonstration by Indian and Japanese vessels
Aerial Display — Coast Guard dornier aircraft and helicopter flypast
Ceremonial Close and Return to Port
